tools.name: zammad_get_me
tools.description: The Zammad user this access token belongs to: id, name, e-mail, roles and groups. Use it to confirm the connection and the token's permissions. GET /api/v1/users/me.

tools.name: zammad_search_tickets

With Elasticsearch on the instance you can use fields, e.g. `state.name:open AND group.name:Sales`, `customer.email:"a@b.com"`, `title:invoice`, `number:20001`; a plain word searches ticket text. tools.name: zammad_list_tickets
tools.description: List the tickets the token's user can see (an agent sees the tickets of their groups; a customer only their own). For anything targeted use zammad_search_tickets. GET /api/v1/tickets?expand=true.

tools.name: zammad_get_ticket
tools.description: One ticket by its numeric id (not the ticket number): title, group, state, priority, owner, customer, organization, dates, escalation and article count. GET /api/v1/tickets/{id}?expand=true.

tools.name: zammad_list_ticket_articles
tools.description: All articles (messages, internal notes, e-mails, phone notes) of one ticket in order, with sender, type, internal flag, from/to/cc, subject, body and attachment names (attachments are not downloaded). Long bodies are cut at 6000 characters; use zammad_get_ticket_article for the full text. GET /api/v

tools.name: zammad_get_ticket_article
tools.description: One article by its id with its full body, headers and attachment names. GET /api/v1/ticket_articles/{id}.

tools.name: zammad_list_ticket_tags
tools.description: The tags on one ticket. GET /api/v1/tags?object=Ticket&o_id={ticket_id}. Needs an agent token.

tools.name: zammad_list_ticket_states
tools.description: The ticket states of the instance (new, open, pending reminder, pending close, closed, ...) with ids and whether they are active. Use the names in zammad_update_ticket. GET /api/v1/ticket_states.

tools.name: zammad_list_ticket_priorities
tools.description: The ticket priorities of the instance (e.g. '1 low', '2 normal', '3 high') with ids. Use the names in zammad_update_ticket. GET /api/v1/ticket_priorities.

tools.name: zammad_list_groups
tools.description: The ticket groups (queues) of the instance, with ids, names and agent ids. Zammad requires the admin.group permission for this list; with an agent-only token it returns an authorization error. GET /api/v1/groups.

tools.name: zammad_search_users
tools.description: Search customers and agents by name, e-mail, login, phone or organization. Returns profile fields (no credentials). Needs an agent token. GET /api/v1/users/search?expand=true.

tools.name: zammad_get_user
tools.description: One user (customer or agent) by id: name, e-mail, phone, organization, roles, VIP flag and notes. No credentials. GET /api/v1/users/{id}?expand=true.

tools.name: zammad_search_organizations
tools.description: Search customer organizations by name or domain. Needs an agent token. GET /api/v1/organizations/search.

tools.name: zammad_list_organizations
tools.description: List customer organizations with domain, VIP flag and member ids. Needs an agent token. GET /api/v1/organizations.

tools.name: zammad_get_organization
tools.description: One organization by id: name, domain, notes, VIP flag, member ids. GET /api/v1/organizations/{id}.

tools.name: zammad_add_internal_note
tools.description: WRITE: add an INTERNAL note (visible to agents only, never e-mailed to the customer) to ONE ticket. Needs an agent's token (a customer's token is refused, because Zammad would make the note public). The ticket's other data is not changed. POST /api/v1/ticket_articles with type=note, internal=true.

tools.name: zammad_reply_to_ticket
tools.description: WRITE: send a customer-visible reply on ONE ticket. THIS E-MAILS A REAL PERSON: the reply is delivered by e-mail to exactly ONE recipient and cannot be recalled. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: zammad_search_tickets, zammad_list_tickets, zammad_get_ticket, zammad_list_ticket_articles, zammad_get_ticket_article, zammad_list_ticket_tags, zammad_list_ticket_states, zammad_list_ticket_priorities, zammad_list_groups, zammad_reply_to_ticket · Private data: zammad_get_me, zammad_list_tickets, zammad_list_ticket_tags, zammad_list_groups, zammad_search_users, zammad_get_user, zammad_search_organizations, zammad_list_organizations, zammad_add_internal_note, zammad_reply_to_ticket · Public sink: zammad_search_tickets, zammad_add_internal_note, zammad_reply_to_ticket, zammad_update_ticket, zammad_create_ticket · Destructive: zammad_update_ticket.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: zammad_search_tickets, zammad_list_tickets, zammad_get_ticket, zammad_list_ticket_articles, zammad_get_ticket_article, zammad_list_ticket_tags, zammad_list_ticket_states, zammad_list_ticket_priorities, zammad_list_groups, zammad_reply_to_ticket · Private data: zammad_get_me, zammad_list_tickets, zammad_list_ticket_tags, zammad_list_groups, zammad_search_users, zammad_get_user, zammad_search_organizations, zammad_list_organizations, zammad_add_internal_note, zammad_reply_to_ticket · Public sink: zammad_search_tickets, zammad_add_internal_note, zammad_reply_to_ticket, zammad_update_ticket, zammad_create_ticket · Destructive: zammad_update_ticket

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
